headline: Mod installs and graphics improvements reach Development builds
summary: Players can install mods from the signed index, resolve dependencies, share setups and receive automatic updates with rollback (#161). That work has not yet been run on Windows, macOS or Android; Steam-library integration was tested on Linux, with Windows and macOS manual checks still needed (#184). Development also gains phone graphics optimizations, diagonal running fixes and Windows sound-gap fixes. The day's 138,618 added and 49,327 removed lines are dominated by the upstream game-source import (#160).
highlights: Android uses Arm ASR or no temporal upscaler, with more Enhanced controls in the drawer (#165, #183).
Windows fixes restore Orxon's electric-barrier strands and correct Batalia explosion colours; Pokitaru's underwater rooms are hidden correctly (#171, #178, #194).
Contributors gain an Object Viewer, Forward+ local lighting and freecam; experimental light authoring remains disabled by default (#195, #196).
Mod SDK 1.11.0 exposes a mod data folder and the current save slot (#172).
Going Commando USA v1.01's native port remains an unmerged draft and is not playable: ship controls are incomplete and most menus untested (#191).
Audio replacement remains open (#164); expanded cross-region co-op, separate saves and host takeover remain a draft, not ready for review or merge (#166).
